en: Transferees from public schools may enroll, subject to the evaluation of their academic records.
However, students transferring from private schools should expect possible delays in the process.
Please note that for private school transferees, previously taken subjects may not be credited.
As a result, you may be required to retake courses as a first-year student.
ceb: Ang mga transferees gikan sa public schools mahimong maka-enroll basta ma-evaluate ang ilang academic records.
Apan ang mga estudyante nga mobalhin gikan sa private schools kinahanglan mag-expect og posibleng delay sa proseso.
Palihog timan-i nga para sa mga transferees gikan sa private schools, posibleng dili ma-credit ang ilang mga previous subjects.
Tungod niini, mahimong kinahanglan nimo kuhaon balik ang mga subject sama sa usa ka first-year student.

en: Students are required to pay for laboratory, ID, and miscellaneous fees. Tuition is free at Bukidnon State University depending on the program you are enrolled in.

However, some courses may have additional charges for laboratory equipment and required textbooks. Your college department may provide some instructions on how you pay for these fees, so it is recommended to check with them for more details.
But you can also ask the accounting office, on the Finance building since they can give you more information about the fees and payment process.
ceb: Mga estudyante kinahanglan magbayad para sa laboratory, ID, ug miscellaneous fees. Libre ang tuition sa Bukidnon State University depende sa programa nga imong gi-enrollan.

Apan, ang uban nga mga kurso posibleng adunay dugang nga bayad para sa laboratory equipment ug required textbooks. Ang imong college department posibleng maghatag og mga instruksyon kung unsaon pagbayad sa mga fees, mao nga girekomenda nga mag-check ka sa ila para sa mas klaro nga detalye.
Pero pwede pud nimo adtuhon ang accounting office, sa Finance building kay sila makahatag og dugang impormasyon bahin sa mga fees ug proseso sa pagbayad.

en: You can access the BukSU SIAS portal using the link provided.
Please use the account credentials assigned to you, which can be found on the BukSU Admission website.
After that you now login to your SIAS account via this link:
https://sias.buksu.edu.ph/sias/
ceb: Pwede nimo ma-access ang BukSU SIAS portal gamit ang gihatag nga link.
Gamiton ang account credentials nga gi-assign sa imoha, nga makita sa BukSU Admission website.
Human niana, mahimo ka na nga mag-login sa imong SIAS account pinaagi niining link:
https://sias.buksu.edu.ph/sias/

en: Yes, transferring to another campus is possible, subject to campus policies and approval.
ceb: Oo, depende sa policy ug approval sa campus.

en: No double enrollment is not allowed. A student must first officially withdraw or secure an Honorable Dismissal from the current school before enrolling in BukSU.
ceb: Dili bawal ang double enrollment. Kinahanglan una ka mo withdraw o mokuha og Honorable Dismissal gikan sa imong kasamtangang eskwelahan sa dili pa ka maka enroll sa BukSU.

en: Enrollment depends on your college.
Some use online, while others combine online and face-to-face enrollment.
ceb: Depende sa imong kolehiyo ang enrollment.
Ang uban online, ang uban kombinasyon sa online ug face-to-face.

en: For your online enrollment.

Step 1: Go to BUKSU Admissions:
https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/
Step 2: Go to the Enrollment tab. On a PC, it’s on the left-side navigation bar. On a mobile phone, click the three-line menu icon at the top left to see the Enrollment tab.
Step 3: Click Apply Enrollment and fill in all the details such as your course, year, and semester.
Step 4: You don’t need to upload documents like your LRN number, student card, or others, as these were already provided during the admission testing process, so you can skip them.
Step 5: Wait for your department to approve your enrollment, then you can directly download your COR for validation.
NOTE: this is for 2nd year students only since they already has a record on their department. for the first year or freshman should submit this forms

Admission Exam Results
Medical Certificate
High School Report Card
Certificate of Good Moral Character
Birth Certificate
ceb: Para sa imong online enrollment:

Step 1: Adto sa BUKSU Admissions:
https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/
Step 2: Adto sa Enrollment tab. Kung PC imong gamit, naa kini sa left-side navigation bar. Kung mobile phone, i-click ang three-line menu icon sa taas nga left aron makita ang Enrollment tab.
Step 3: I-click ang Apply Enrollment ug pun-a tanan nga detalye sama sa imong course, year, ug semester.
Step 4: Dili na kinahanglan mag-upload og mga dokumento sama sa imong LRN number, student card, ug uban pa, kay na-submit na kini sa admission testing process, mao nga pwede ra nimo sila i-skip.
Step 5: Hulata nga ma-approve sa imong department ang imong enrollment, unya pwede na nimo i-download diretso ang imong COR para sa validation.
NOTE: kini para lamang sa 2nd year students kay naa na silay record sa ilang department. Para sa first year o freshman kinahanglan mo-submit niini nga mga porma

Admission Exam Results
Medical Certificate
High School Report Card
Certificate of Good Moral Character
Birth Certificate

en: For mixed enrollment, the process is similar to online enrollment fill up all the requirements on bukSU Admission, for the process just ask about online enrollment. but this time you need to go to your department to process your pending online enrollment. There are specific faculty staff who handle enrollment in your department. Sometimes there is a queue system that you need to scan to know your number in line for your turn.
but this is for 2nd year student only since they already has a record on their department. for freshman and transferees follow this steps
1. Attend the Pre-enrolment Orientation.
2. Proceed to the preferred college of choice for personal interview and present documents in a long brown envelope for evaluation.

3. Proceed to the I.T. Laboratory for the Information System Registration& submit documents.
Requirements for Incoming Freshmen:
Admission Exam Results
High School Report Card
Certificate of Good Moral Character
Birth Certificate
Individual Inventory Record

Requirements for Transferees:
Admission Exam Results
Medical Certificate
Birth Certificate
Honorable Dismissal
Transcript of Records 
Individual Inventory Record
ceb: For mixed enrollment, parehas ra ang proseso sa online enrollment—pun-a tanan nga requirements sa BukSU Admission. Para sa proseso, pwede ka mangutana bahin sa online enrollment. Apan karon, kinahanglan ka moadto sa inyong department aron iproseso ang imong pending online enrollment. Adunay mga specific nga faculty staff nga nag-handle sa enrollment sa inyong department. Usahay, adunay queue system nga kinahanglan nimo i-scan aron mahibal-an ang imong numero sa linya para sa imong turno.
Apan kini para lamang sa 2nd year student kay naa na silay record sa ilang department. Para sa freshmen ug transferees, sundan kini nga mga lakang:
1. Motambong sa Pre-enrolment Orientation.
2. Moadto sa napiling college para sa personal interview ug ipresent ang mga dokumento sulod sa long brown envelope para sa evaluation.

3. Moadto sa I.T. Laboratory para sa Information System Registration& ug ipasa ang mga dokumento.
Requirements for Incoming Freshmen:
Admission Exam Results
High School Report Card
Certificate of Good Moral Character
Birth Certificate
Individual Inventory Record

Requirements for Transferees:
Admission Exam Results
Medical Certificate
Birth Certificate
Honorable Dismissal
Transcript of Records
Individual Inventory Record

en: If you’re a freshman, you need to bring your Report of Ratings (ROR) and your application form, which can be downloaded from your BukSU Admission account.
You should also bring your birth certificate, report card (a photocopy is fine if you don’t have the original), LRN, diploma, and good moral certificate.
After that, you can proceed to the department where you want to enroll.
For those enrolling in the 2nd semester, you just need to apply for online enrollment for your continuing course and then proceed to the faculty to process your enrollment.
ceb: Kung ikaw usa ka freshman, kinahanglan nimo dad-on ang imong Report of Ratings (ROR) ug ang imong application form, nga pwede nimo i-download gikan sa imong BukSU Admission account.
Kinahanglan usab nimo dad-on ang birth certificate, report card (pwede ang photocopy kung wala kay original), LRN, diploma, ug good moral certificate.
Human niini, mahimo ka na moadto sa departamento nga imong gustong sudlan.
Para sa mga mo-enroll sa 2nd semester, kinahanglan lang nga mag-apply sa online enrollment para sa imong padayon nga kurso, unya adtoa ang faculty aron iproseso ang imong enrollment.

en: Late enrollment is still allowed at Bukidnon State University but it is subject to spacific condetions.
According to the official policy of the University Registrar, late enrollment is permitted only during the first week of classes.

For more details about enrollment click this link:
https://buksu.edu.ph/office-of-the-registrar/registration/
ceb: Ang late enrollment gitugotan gihapon sa Bukidnon State University apan naa kini sa espesipikong mga kondisyon.
Sumala sa opisyal nga polisiya sa University Registrar, ang late enrollment gitugotan lamang sulod sa unang semana sa klase.

Para sa dugang detalye bahin sa enrollment, i-klik kini nga link:
https://buksu.edu.ph/office-of-the-registrar/registration/
